# eidotter

> DOS-themed React component library with authentic CGA/amber phosphor aesthetics.

## Quick Facts
- 32 components (Alert, Accordion, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Card, ChatMessage, ChatHistory, ChatInput, ChatContainer, Checkbox, CommandPrompt, FilterBar, Icon, InlineExpand, Input, Modal, Nav, Progress, RetroEffects, Separator, Stat, Switch, Tabs, Tag, Terminal, TextScramble, TimelineContainer, TimelineEntry, TimelineList, TimelineNode, Tokens)
- Dark theme only (amber-on-black phosphor CRT aesthetic)
- CSS custom properties + Tailwind preset
- React 18/19, Tailwind 3/4 compatible
- Published on npm: `npm install eidotter`

## Key Principle
NEVER hardcode colors. Always use:
- CSS: `var(--color-semantic-*)` or `var(--color-cga-*)`
- Tailwind: `text-cga-amber`, `bg-dos-bg-primary`, etc.

## Files for AI Agents
- CLAUDE.md: Coding instructions and component patterns
- docs/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md: DOS aesthetic paradigms (the "why")
- docs/TOKENS.md: Token reference with usage examples (the "what")
- docs/INTEGRATION.md: Framework integration patterns (the "how")

## Token Categories
- `--color-semantic-*`: USE THESE for components (background, text, border, status)
- `--color-cga-*`: Raw CGA palette (16 colors + amber extensions)
- `--typography-*`: Font family, size, weight, line-height
- `--spacing-*`: 8px grid scale (0-16)
- `--shadow-*`: DOS drop shadows + phosphor glow effects

## Essential Tokens

### Backgrounds
- `--color-semantic-background-primary` → `bg-dos-bg-primary` (main background, #020003)
- `--color-semantic-background-secondary` → `bg-dos-bg-secondary` (surfaces, #010103)
- `--color-semantic-background-accent` → `bg-dos-bg-accent` (buttons, #ffb000)

### Text
- `--color-semantic-text-primary` → `text-dos-text-primary` (body text, #b87c1a)
- `--color-semantic-text-accent` → `text-dos-text-accent` (highlights, #e5b936)
- `--color-cga-amber` → `text-cga-amber` (brightest amber, #ffb000)

### Borders
- `--color-semantic-border-default` → `border-dos-border-default` (#b87c1a)
- `--color-semantic-border-focus` → `border-dos-border-focus` (#e5b936)

### Effects
- `--shadow-glow-md` → `shadow-dos-glowMd` (phosphor glow)
- `--shadow-drop` → `shadow-dos-drop` (DOS window shadow)

## Component List with Purpose
- Alert: Dismissible messages (info, success, warning, error)
- Accordion: Collapsible sections (Section + AccordionFill)
- Badge: Status indicators, tags
- Breadcrumb: Navigation path
- Button: Actions (primary, secondary, ghost, danger)
- Card: Content containers
- Checkbox: Boolean inputs
- CommandPrompt: DOS command line aesthetic
- Icon: 89 icons (Calendar, Star, Check, etc.)
- Input: Text fields
- Modal: Dialog overlays (uses native dialog element)
- Progress: Loading/completion bars
- RetroEffects: CRT scanlines, phosphor glow
- Stat: Key-value metric display with trends
- Switch: Toggle controls
- Tabs: Tab navigation (default, pills, underline variants)
- Terminal: DOS window frame (controls hidden by default — pass minimizable/maximizable/closeable to enable)
- TimelineContainer: Multi-zoom timeline (year/month/day/hour views). Supports mode="static" for read-only vertical feed (replaces TimelineList). Shared TimelineEntryData type.
- TimelineNode: Timeline markers (circle/square/diamond, labels no longer truncated)
- Footer: Site footer with default legal links (Impressum + Datenschutz). Exports defaultLegalLinks constant.
- TimelineList: DEPRECATED — use TimelineContainer mode="static" instead
- FilterBar: Multi-select filter toolbar with keyboard navigation
- Tag: Interactive labels, filter chips, closeable tags (+ TagGroup wrapper)
- ChatMessage: Single chat message with role-based DOS styling (user >, assistant C:\>, system italic) and streaming cursor
- ChatHistory: Scrollable message list with auto-scroll, role="log" accessibility, empty state
- ChatInput: Multiline DOS-styled textarea with Enter-to-send, Shift+Enter for newlines, auto-grow
- ChatContainer: Composes ChatHistory + ChatInput — place inside Terminal for full DOS chat window
- InlineExpand: Inline text disclosure widget
- Nav: DOS-themed navigation (DesktopNav + MobileNav)
- Separator: Horizontal/vertical content divider
- TextScramble: DOS text decode/glitch effect
- TimelineList: Data-driven timeline list
- TimelineEntry: Timeline list item

## Anti-Patterns (NEVER DO)
- NEVER hardcode hex colors: `color: #FFB000`
- NEVER use `prefers-color-scheme` (eidotter is dark-only)
- NEVER edit tokens.css directly (edit JSON, rebuild)
- NEVER use rounded corners > 4px (DOS aesthetic)
- NEVER use light backgrounds
- NEVER use sans-serif fonts

## Integration Quick Start
```css
/* In your globals.css */
@import "eidotter/tokens.css";
@import "eidotter/styles";

:root { color-scheme: dark; }
html { background: var(--color-semantic-background-primary); }
body {
  color: var(--color-semantic-text-primary);
  font-family: var(--typography-font-family-primary);
}
```

```js
// In tailwind.config.js
module.exports = {
  presets: [require('eidotter/tailwind.preset.cjs')],
}
```
